title: Grateful Dead Live at Recreation Hall - University of California on 1982-03-14
source: Master Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture with ripping Jerry and Bob solos, though the show opened with a quirky moment.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its great sound quality, likely a clean sound‑board source. Reviewers highlight fiery solo work from both Jerry Garcia and Bob Weir, calling the performances “rips.” Aside from an odd opening comment about forgetting something, the overall vibe is positive.

ai_rating.rationale: Two strong 5‑star comments praise sound and performance; one 0‑star comment drags the average down, resulting in a solid but not flawless rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes great sound with no reported issues; clear and balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific setlist comments; focus is on solo intensity.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s solos are described as “ripping” and a highlight of the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir delivers strong, ripping solos alongside Garcia.
